review.review: Blocked alive, not dead: decision 439 (log lines 1281–1282) waits at cell 281 with 25/25 HP while elapsed turns advance from 431 to 432. Mandatory pool retrieval remained unfinished. Initiating defect: after invisibility was publicly identified (decision 169, line 485), the known-supply staging helper still reused unknown-potion test-bank restrictions and a dry-only approach filter. Decision 174 (line 495) therefore explored instead of preparing the remembered chest. Offline reconstruction using the played source and public inputs matched actions and reasons through decision 174, including runner recovery and accepted-input bookkeeping. Its dry-run alternatives showed ordinary approach water at 410 outside the remembered habitat, an adjacent closed entrance at 449, and a budget-admitted chest trip to 646. The original helper rejected every candidate. The focused correction admits only identified-invisibility staging on observed ordinary water, retaining hazard exclusions, arrival visibility, actionable entrance opening and existing protected-trip budgeting. An isolated candidate probe on the validated pre-174 state selected approach movement instead; no subsequent observations were supplied. New regression: original source has two expected assertion failures; candidate passes all four cases. Full suite: 1535 tests passed, four skipped. Policy and new regression are changed locally; files is empty as required for adapter-derived changes. This does not establish completed retrieval, a safe unknown-potion test, or improved survival.
review.learnings: Separate identified protection staging from unknown-potion testing. Ordinary approach water outside the remembered piranha habitat can be considered only with observed hazard checks, a visible arrival recheck, an actionable entrance and a verified protection budget. Preparation is not collection.
